title: Faculty Directory and Department Contacts
content:
CampusAI University comprises several departments with dedicated faculty members. The primary departments are:
- Computer Science and Engineering (CSE): Contact at cse@campusai.edu, Ext: 401. Main office: Block A, Room 301.
- Information Technology (IT): Contact at it@campusai.edu, Ext: 402. Main office: Block A, Room 305.
- Electronics and Communication (ECE): Contact at ece@campusai.edu, Ext: 403. Main office: Block B, Room 201.
- Mechanical Engineering (ME): Contact at me@campusai.edu, Ext: 404. Main office: Block C, Room 101.
Each department has a dedicated admin desk available Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

title: Faculty Office Hours and Consultations
content:
All professors maintain weekly office hours for student queries, project guidance, and doubts clarification. Students are encouraged to book appointments beforehand or visit during the designated hours:
- Dr. Alan Turing (CSE HOD): Mon & Wed, 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM (Block A, Room 302)
- Prof. Grace Hopper (CSE): Tue & Thu, 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM (Block A, Room 308)
- Dr. Claude Shannon (ECE HOD): Wed & Fri, 1:00 PM - 3:00 PM (Block B, Room 202)
- Prof. Ada Lovelace (IT HOD): Mon & Thu, 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM (Block A, Room 306)
Consultation slots can also be scheduled online through the Faculty Scheduler tab on the student portal.

title: Head of Department (HOD) Contact Information
content:
For administrative issues, course approvals, or special permissions, students should contact their respective HODs:
- CSE HOD: Dr. Alan Turing, Email: cse_hod@campusai.edu, Office: Block A, Room 302, Extension: 411.
- IT HOD: Prof. Ada Lovelace, Email: it_hod@campusai.edu, Office: Block A, Room 306, Extension: 412.
- ECE HOD: Dr. Claude Shannon, Email: ece_hod@campusai.edu, Office: Block B, Room 202, Extension: 413.
- ME HOD: Dr. James Watt, Email: me_hod@campusai.edu, Office: Block C, Room 102, Extension: 414.
Ensure you have a formal request letter and relevant documents before meeting the HOD.
